strings.zh: 我是来挑战红莲道馆的,{NEWLINE}可是在这里找了好久{CLEAR}都没发现道馆在哪里。
strings.en: I came to challenge the Cinnabar Gym,{NEWLINE}but I’ve been searching here forever{CLEAR}and still can’t find it.

strings.zh: 红莲岛不就是个火山口嘛,{NEWLINE}真不知道有什么好看的,{CLEAR}居然能吸引这么多游客来。
strings.en: Cinnabar Island’s just a volcano{NEWLINE}crater, isn’t it?{SCROLL}I really don’t get what’s so great{NEWLINE}about it that it draws so many tourists.

strings.zh: 旅游杂志「Cheat Book」上拍出来的{NEWLINE}红莲岛照片好唯美好好看,{CLEAR}我也想在这里拍一组那种照片。
strings.en: The photos of Cinnabar Island in the{NEWLINE}travel magazine ‘Cheat Book’ are so{CLEAR}dreamy and gorgeous.{SCROLL}I want to take a set of photos like that{NEWLINE}here too.

strings.zh: 大家都说红莲道馆的水平很强,{NEWLINE}华蓝道馆的水平很弱。{CLEAR}可是如果让两家馆主来一场战斗的话,{CLEAR}我觉得红莲道馆的馆主{CLEAR}未必就能轻松战胜华蓝道馆的馆主,{CLEAR}究其原因就是火系被水系完克。{SCROLL}所以说绝对强的精灵是不存在的,{NEWLINE}根据对手的特点制定好战术{CLEAR}才是取胜的关键。
strings.en: Everyone says the Cinnabar Gym is{NEWLINE}really strong and the Cerulean Gym is{CLEAR}really weak.{SCROLL}But if the two Gym Leaders battled, I{NEWLINE}don’t think the Cinnabar Leader would{CLEAR}beat the Cerulean Leader so easily.{SCROLL}The reason is simple: Water completely{NEWLINE}counters Fire.{SCROLL}So there’s no such thing as an{NEWLINE}absolutely strong Pokémon.{SCROLL}Planning your tactics around your{NEWLINE}opponent’s traits is the key to winning.

strings.zh: 自从夏伯把红莲道馆关掉以后,{NEWLINE}能获得深红徽章的人就少之又少了。{CLEAR}如果你能拿深红徽章{CLEAR}来给我看一看的话,{CLEAR}我就送你个好东西。
strings.en: Ever since Blaine closed down the{NEWLINE}Cinnabar Gym, hardly anyone has earned{CLEAR}the Volcano Badge.{SCROLL}If you can show me a Volcano Badge, I’ll{NEWLINE}give you something good.

strings.zh: 哇哇哇,{NEWLINE}你拿的那个不就是深红徽章吗？{CLEAR}这闪耀着火焰光芒的徽章真是太美了。{CLEAR}谢谢你能把这么珍贵的徽章拿给我看,{CLEAR}请收下这个吧。
strings.en: Wow wow wow, isn’t that the Volcano{NEWLINE}Badge you’ve got?{SCROLL}This Badge shining with the glow of{NEWLINE}flames is just gorgeous.{SCROLL}Thank you for showing me such a{NEWLINE}precious Badge. Please take this.

strings.zh: 这个里面是燃烧殆尽,{NEWLINE}用尽精灵的力气打出火焰攻击,{CLEAR}虽说会有点副作用,{CLEAR}但威力绝对是数一数二的。
strings.en: This contains Overheat.{SCROLL}It unleashes a Fire attack with every{NEWLINE}last bit of a Pokémon’s strength.{SCROLL}It has a drawback, but its power is{NEWLINE}among the very best.

strings.zh: 夏伯可能是使用火系精灵的高手,{NEWLINE}但我觉得他本人应该不会喷火吧？
strings.en: Blaine might be a master of Fire-type{NEWLINE}Pokémon, but I bet he can’t breathe{CLEAR}fire himself, right?

strings.zh: 我还以为火焰鸟{NEWLINE}是什么神圣的鸟呢,{CLEAR}弄了半天原来是个攻击人类的凶鸟。
strings.en: I thought Moltres was some kind of{NEWLINE}sacred bird.{SCROLL}Turns out it’s a vicious bird that{NEWLINE}attacks people.
